hookups.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/chapman-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880104 (per-site catalog: 54 public sites list 50-amp, 1 lists 30-amp; the 21 Full-Hookup sites list water and sewer), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 77 campsites on the booking site (34 Modern Electric, 21 Full-Hookup, 10 Modern Non-Electric, 12 walk-to) besides cottages, yurts and group tenting; DCNR says approximately 80. Listed max vehicle lengths run 20-60 ft on most sites (75 ft at site 66); the two pull-throughs (Upper Loop sites 44 and 60, full hookup) list 100 ft. Every other site is back-in.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/chapman-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880104 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/chapman-state-park/stay ('modern restrooms, water at convenient hydrants, and a sanitary dump station') + ReserveAmerica park page amenities ('Flush Toilets Are Available In The Campground', 'Showers Are Available In The Campground', 'Sanitation Dumping Station Is Available In The Campground'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites (Full-Hookup, Modern Electric, Modern Non-Electric, Walk To) can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; season (mid-April to mid-December) already manual. Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at 21 full-hookup sites, 77 campsites (two 100-ft pull-throughs, the rest back-in up to 75 ft), showers/flush toilets/hydrant water/dump. Not stated for this park: min/max stay, the noon cutoff, fcfs (left inherited). Fees left as recorded (statewide table; nothing on these pages).
